responsibility: Implements the x86 SSE4A intrinsic header used by GCC for AMD-specific vector and scalar memory/bitfield operations. It conditionally enables the sse4a target option and defines inline wrappers/macros for the SSE4A builtins such as non-temporal scalar stores and EXTRQ/INSERTQ forms, serving as the front-end API layer that converts Intel/AMD intrinsic names into GCC’s underlying x86 builtin calls.
